method: same hard HH forward; rising fast-sigmoid surrogate, 200ms truncated BPTT and clipped per-ms state adjoints
parameter_group_policy: class and annotated type; same factors for homologues; no side or per-cell free offsets
scope: local coupled circuit plus all candidate-mapped MNs; other cells replay frozen exact baseline spike events; candidate must be checked in original full hard-spike network
selection: lowest training waveform MSE plus regularization; holdout never selects parameters
missing_mapping_policy: 26 unmapped channels remain zero requested input; excluded from optimized loss and reported separately in all130 error
optimizer: Adam with cosine learning-rate decay; no early stopping
epoch_definition: one complete 200–1100ms training-window forward/backward pass and one Adam update; previous short trials do not count
